reasoning: Basing the new Resource on the checked Skill Weighing Coral by Touch: Xene still carries and trusts her father's old Ragusan balance-scale over the newer steelyards Alexandria's factors use, an archaic habit that undercuts her disguise.

operations.name: A Ragusan Balance-Scale
operations.description: worn bronze pans from my father's shop; I trust nothing else to weigh true, though it marks me as a relic among the newer merchants

operations.text: For all my new name and new tongue, I still weigh coral on my father's old bronze balance-scale rather than the steelyards the young factors favor — a small vanity that marks me instantly as a relic to anyone paying attention.
